title: From feedstock to fuel: how an ethanol plant works
body:
## The short version

Grain, cane juice or biomass goes in. Fuel-grade ethanol, by-products and recycled water come out.

## The main stages

- **Feedstock** is received and prepared
- **Fermentation** turns sugars into alcohol
- **Distillation** concentrates the alcohol (ENA or rectified spirit)
- **Dehydration** brings it to anhydrous, fuel grade

## Nothing is wasted

Spent wash is concentrated in **MEE** evaporators, by-products are dried, and **ZLD** systems recover the water for reuse.

#Ethanol #HowItWorks #MEE #ZLD
